description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for the Würth Elektronik WSEN TIDS sensor, including initialization, data fetching, configuration, and macros for device instantiation.

methods.name: tids_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches raw temperature data from the sensor.

methods.name: tids_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: tids_odr_set
methods.description: Sets the output data rate for the sensor.

methods.name: tids_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as sampling frequency and thresholds.

methods.name: tids_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, checks device ID, resets, and configures operational modes.
